description:
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Rattleclaw Mystic.
Rattleclaw Mystic dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Yedora and Skullclamp trigger.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning Rattleclaw Mystic from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate Rattleclaw Mystic by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Rattleclaw Mystic's morph ability by paying {2}, turning it face up.
Rattleclaw Mystic triggers, adding {G}{U}{R}.
Repeat.
